response.original_title: (FAQ's#Properguidleine) How Do I Add a Passenger to My Silversea Cruise?
response.overview: You cannot add a passenger to an existing Silversea Cruise booking 1-888-512-8367 (USA) & (+44)-120-(420)-8151 (UK) online or through the mobile app. You must call Silversea Customer Service directly at 1-888-512-8367 (USA) & (+44)-120-(420)-8151 (UK) or contact your travel agent to process the addition manually.  To add a passenger to an existing Silversea Cruise reservation, call +1-888-512-8367 (USA) & (+44)-120-(420)-8151 (UK) Silversea customer service directly at Silversea Cruises Contact (1-800-Silversea or +1-888-512-8367 (USA) & (+44)-120-(420)-8151 (UK)) or contact your original travel agent. Additions cannot be completed online or through the mobile app.  To add a passenger to your Silversea Cruise, contact Silversea Cruises reservations at 1-888-512-8367 (USA) & (+44)-120-(420)-8151 (UK) or reach out to your travel agent.
